# Decompose MainStreetEngine.ts

## Problem
MainStreetEngine.ts is 4003 lines — the largest god module. It bundles day start, market phase, investment resolution, income phase, incident phase, end-check, action dispatch, scoring, event resolution, competitive mode logic, AI helpers, and command implementations.

## Goal
Split into focused modules:
- `MainStreetEngineDayStart.ts` — Day start logic (executeDayStart, executeCompetitiveDayStart, advanceWeek, appendTurnNetRow) (<300 lines)
- `MainStreetEngineMarketPhase.ts` — Market phase action handling (executeAction, consumeAction, executeCompetitiveDay — market portion) (<500 lines)
- `MainStreetEngineScoring.ts` — Scoring (computeScore, updateScore, updateCompetitiveScores, projectEventCoinDelta, eventSeverity, decideEventChoice, resolveEventChoice, AI helpers) (<600 lines)
- `MainStreetEngineEventResolution.ts` — Event/income/incident resolution (resolveEvent, playHeldEvent, resolveHeldInvestment, resolveIncident, resolveCompetitiveClosingPhases, resolveCompetitivePendingChoice) (<800 lines)
- `MainStreetEngineCommands.ts` — Command implementations (placeFromHand, sellFromHand, sellFromTableau, canPlaceFromHand, canSellFromHand, canSellFromTableau, executeSell, canSellBusiness, applyStaff/Community/Business ongoing costs, executeCommunityFavour, peekIncidentDeck, checkImmediateLoss, checkCompetitiveEndConditions, checkEndConditions, hireStaffApplicant, declineStaffApplicant, applyCompetitiveOngoingCosts, processEndOfTurn, finishDeferredEndOfTurn, finishDeferredTurnClosing, endTurnHeadless, executeFullTurn, resolvePendingEventChoice, setPhase, advancePhase, applyEndOfurnDeltas) (<1200 lines — this may need further splitting)
- `MainStreetEngineTypes.ts` — Action types, TurnResult, TurnResult deltas, EndOfTurnOptions, EventChoiceResolution (<200 lines)

**If Commands.ts stays >800 lines, split further:**
- `MainStreetEnginePlaceSell.ts` — placeFromHand, sellFromHand, sellFromTableau, canPlaceFromHand, canSellFromHand, canSellFromTableau, executeSell, canSellBusiness
- `MainStreetEngineEndOfTurn.ts` — processEndOfTurn, finishDeferredEndOfTurn, finishDeferredTurnClosing, endTurnHeadless, executeFullTurn, applyEndOfTurnDeltas, applyStaff/Community/Business ongoing costs

## Acceptance Criteria
1. MainStreetEngine.ts reduced to <800 lines (barrel re-exporting sub-modules)
2. Each new module has a single responsibility, documented in a module comment
3. No circular dependencies — Engine depends on State, Cards, Adjacency, Market
4. All public function signatures and types unchanged
5. All existing imports resolve via the barrel — no consumer changes needed
6. Build succeeds (`npm run build`)
7. Main Street engine tests pass (main-street-engine-deltas.test.ts, event-choice.test.ts, MainStreetEventChoice.test.ts, transcript-recording.test.ts)

## Key Files
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts` — Source module (4003 lines)
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngineDayStart.ts` — Extracted day start
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngineMarketPhase.ts` — Extracted market phase
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngineScoring.ts` — Extracted scoring/AI helpers
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngineEventResolution.ts` — Extracted event/income/incident resolution
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngineCommands.ts` — Extracted command implementations
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngineEndOfTurn.ts` — Extracted end-of-turn flow (if needed)
- `tests/main-street/main-street-engine-deltas.test.ts` — Engine delta tests
- `tests/main-street/event-choice.test.ts` — Event choice tests
- `tests/main-street/transcript-recording.test.ts` — Transcript tests

## Risks
- High risk: Engine is the most complex module; behavioral regression is the primary concern
- processEndOfTurn is the central orchestrator — its interface must remain stable
- Deferred closing (deferResourceApplication) logic is intertwined — must extract carefully
- Competitive mode functions (resolveCompetitiveClosingPhases, executeCompetitiveDay) are complex
- AI helpers (decideEventChoice, resolveEventChoice) are pure but deeply nested — must extract with correct state access patterns
- The "engine" module name is ambiguous — consider `MainStreetGameLogic.ts` for the barrel
data.title: Decompose MainStreetEngine.ts into day start, market phase, scoring, event resolution, commands, and end-of-turn modules

# Decompose MainStreetAnimator.ts

## Problem
MainStreetAnimator.ts is 2475 lines, bundling income phase choreography (with ~20 timing constants), synergy line animation, card movement/transfers, market deal-in, incident reveal, celebration effects, HUD updates, and utility getters.

## Goal
Split into focused modules:
- `MainStreetAnimatorIncome.ts` — Income animation (all INCOME_* constants, IncomePhaseKey, IncomePhaseOptions, animateIncomePhases, runIncomePhase, eventDeltaEffects, synergyPhaseSources, countOutCoins, revealInGrid, flyCoinsIn, flyCoinsOut, creditedIncomeTotal, showIncomePhaseLabel, animateHudValueChanges, resetCoinStaggerForTurn, private stagger helpers) (<800 lines)
- `MainStreetAnimatorSynergy.ts` — Synergy line animation (animateSynergyFormation, popSynergyText, findStreetCardContainer) (<200 lines)
- `MainStreetAnimatorMarket.ts` — Market animations (animateMarketDealIn, animatePeekReveal, getMarketCardCenter, animateMarketSwap — private, animateApplicantWalkOn/Off/In) (<400 lines)
- `MainStreetAnimatorUtility.ts` — Utility functions (animateCelebration, animateIncidentReveal, animateIncidentDeltaBubbles — private, animateDayBanner, animateGameOver, animateUndoRedo, animateLevelUp, animateSell, animateClose, animateEventPlayed, getStreetSlotCenter/localSlotCentre, getHandCardCenter, createTransferCardVisual, cleanupTransferAnimations, animateTransferFromMarket, applyPendingDeltasOnce — private, collectIncomeGrids — private, getMarketSlotCenter) (<600 lines)

**If Income.ts stays >800 lines, split further:**
- `MainStreetAnimatorIncomeTimings.ts` — All INCOME_* constants + stagger helpers + getCardDelay/getFlightDuration/getIconStagger
- `MainStreetAnimatorIncomeChoreography.ts` — animateIncomePhases, runIncomePhase, coin flight/coin counting

## Acceptance Criteria
1. MainStreetAnimator.ts reduced to <800 lines (barrel re-exporting sub-modules)
2. Each new module has a single responsibility, documented in a module comment
3. No circular dependencies — Animator depends on Cards, Adjacency for visual data
4. MainStreetAnimator class constructor and all public methods preserved
5. All existing imports resolve via the barrel — no consumer changes needed
6. Build succeeds (`npm run build`)
7. Main Street animator tests pass (synergy-formation-animator.test.ts)

## Key Files
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetAnimator.ts` — Source module (2475 lines)
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorIncome.ts` — Extracted income choreography
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorSynergy.ts` — Extracted synergy animation
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorMarket.ts` — Extracted market animations
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetAnimatorUtility.ts` — Extracted utility animations
- `tests/main-street/synergy-formation-animator.test.ts` — Synergy animation test

## Risks
- Medium risk: Animation timing constants are tightly coupled — extract as a group
- animateIncomePhases is ~400 lines of complex Phaser time-based choreography — must preserve exact timing
- Some private helpers (collectIncomeGrids, applyPendingDeltasOnce) are tightly coupled to animateIncomePhases — extract together
- getStreetSlotCenter and localSlotCentre are used by Renderer for drag-drop — must remain accessible
data.title: Decompose MainStreetAnimator.ts into income, synergy, market, and utility animation modules

# Decompose MainStreetRenderer.ts

- `MainStreetRendererMarket.ts` — Market rendering (refreshMarket, drawMarketRow, getMarketRowCards, getMarketSlotCenter, drawMarketCard, getFrontIncidentCardCenter, refreshIncidentQueue, animateUpcomingEffectLine) (<500 lines)

## Acceptance Criteria
1. MainStreetRenderer.ts reduced to <800 lines (barrel re-exporting sub-modules)

- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRendererMarket.ts` — Extracted market rendering
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts` — Extracted HUD rendering

# Decompose MainStreetLifecycleManager.ts

- `MainStreetLifecycleManagerPersistence.ts` — Persistence (checkForSavedCheckpoint, loadBoardState, handleResize) (<300 lines)
- `MainStreetLifecycleManagerPrewarm.ts` — CSV/SVG prewarm (checkForCsvMismatchAndRegenerate) (<200 lines)

## Acceptance Criteria

2. Each new module has a single responsibility, documented in a module comment
3. No circular dependencies — LifecycleManager depends on State, Cards, Engine
4. MainStreetLifecycleManager class constructor and all public methods preserved
5. All existing imports resolve via the barrel — no consumer changes needed
6. Build succeeds (`npm run build`)
7. Main Street tutorial tests pass (tutorial-state.test.ts, tutorial-flow.test.ts)

## Key Files

data.comment: Implementation complete. MainStreetEngine.ts (4003) -> 149-line barrel + 8 modules: Types (266), Scoring (210), DayStart (96), CompetitiveTurn (331), Actions (454), Events (472), TurnClosing (998), Commands (1218). All 90 exports preserved (plus the module's convenience re-exports). Acyclic: Types/Events/Commands are leaves; Scoring->Events; DayStart->Commands; Actions->Commands/Events/Scoring; TurnClosing->Actions/Events/Scoring/Commands/DayStart; CompetitiveTurn->all. PLAN DEVIATION: the plan's 6 modules could not be acyclic because executeAction<->consumeAction<->executeCommunityFavour<->peekIncidentDeck and the single-player turn-closing recursion (processEndOfTurn/resolveIncident/checkEndConditions/endTurnHeadless/...) form strongly-connected clusters; grouped those clusters into single modules (Actions, TurnClosing) and moved 2 event helpers (computeDurationWithClinicReduction, isTheftLossIncident) from TurnClosing to Events to break the Events<->TurnClosing cycle. TurnClosing/Commands exceed the plan's soft per-module targets; the primary barrel is 149 lines (<800). Verified: build green, 0 tsc errors, unit 6719 passed | 8 skipped. Pushed to dev as 045880c1. Gate: build + unit (producer-approved).
